indicators.name: UK Real GDP growth
indicators.context: Quarterly real growth measures output momentum. It is not annualized, so compare its basis before comparing it with the US GDP headline.
indicators.description: Real GDP, chain-volume measure, seasonally adjusted; quarterly growth, not annualized. Source: Office for National Statistics. Reviewed 2026-10-27.

indicators.name: UK Consumer inflation (CPI)
indicators.context: This is annual consumer-price inflation, not the monthly price change. A lower rate means slower price increases, not necessarily falling prices.
indicators.description: All-items CPI, percentage change over 12 months; not seasonally adjusted. Source: Office for National Statistics. Reviewed 2026-10-27.

indicators.name: UK Unemployment rate
indicators.context: The labour-market reading is a rolling three-month estimate, so it should not be treated as a single-month rate. Overlapping windows smooth short-term changes.
indicators.description: ILO unemployment rate, age 16+, seasonally adjusted, rolling three-month average. The API dates observations by the middle month of each window. Source: Office for National Statistics. Reviewed 2026-10-27.

indicators.name: Germany Real GDP growth
indicators.context: Real quarterly GDP tracks output rather than prices. Compare this non-annualized growth rate with other countries on the same basis.
indicators.description: Chain-linked real GDP, seasonally and calendar adjusted, quarterly growth; not annualized. Source: Eurostat. Reviewed 2026-10-27.

indicators.name: Germany Consumer inflation (HICP)
indicators.context: HICP provides a harmonised European measure of consumer-price inflation. Its coverage and weights can differ from the national CPI.
indicators.description: All-items harmonised consumer-price inflation, COICOP 2018; annual rate of change. HICP is not the national CPI. Source: Eurostat. Reviewed 2026-10-27.

indicators.name: Germany Unemployment rate
indicators.context: This is the harmonised survey-based unemployment rate, rather than the count of people registered for unemployment benefits.
indicators.description: Total unemployment rate, both sexes, seasonally adjusted, percentage of the labour force. Eurostat total covers ages 15–74. Source: Eurostat. Reviewed 2026-10-27.

indicators.name: France Real GDP growth
indicators.context: Real quarterly GDP tracks output rather than prices. Compare this non-annualized growth rate with other countries on the same basis.
indicators.description: Chain-linked real GDP, seasonally and calendar adjusted, quarterly growth; not annualized. Source: Eurostat. Reviewed 2026-10-27.

indicators.name: France Consumer inflation (HICP)
indicators.context: HICP provides a harmonised European measure of consumer-price inflation. Its coverage and weights can differ from the national CPI.
indicators.description: All-items harmonised consumer-price inflation, COICOP 2018; annual rate of change. HICP is not the national CPI. Source: Eurostat. Reviewed 2026-10-27.

indicators.name: France Unemployment rate
indicators.context: This is the harmonised survey-based unemployment rate, rather than the count of people registered for unemployment benefits.
indicators.description: Total unemployment rate, both sexes, seasonally adjusted, percentage of the labour force. Eurostat total covers ages 15–74. Source: Eurostat. Reviewed 2026-10-27.

indicators.name: Japan Real GDP growth
indicators.context: This is quarterly real GDP growth on a non-annualized basis. It measures output momentum rather than the annual pace often quoted in Japanese GDP headlines.
indicators.description: Real expenditure GDP, 2020 base, seasonally adjusted quarterly percentage change; not annualized. This service uses the API feature of Statistics Dashboard, but the contents of this service are not guaranteed by the Statistics Bureau of Japan. Source: Statistics Bureau / Cabinet Office of Japan. Reviewed 2026-10-27.

indicators.name: Japan Consumer inflation (CPI)
indicators.context: All-items inflation includes fresh food and energy. It should not be confused with Japan’s commonly quoted CPI excluding fresh food.
indicators.description: All-items consumer price inflation, 2025 base, change from the same month a year earlier; original series. This service uses the API feature of Statistics Dashboard, but the contents of this service are not guaranteed by the Statistics Bureau of Japan. Source: Statistics Bureau / Cabinet Office of Japan. Reviewed 2026-10-27.

indicators.name: Japan Unemployment rate
indicators.context: The seasonally adjusted unemployment rate helps distinguish labour-market changes from recurring seasonal patterns.
indicators.description: Unemployment rate, both sexes, seasonally adjusted, monthly Labour Force Survey. This service uses the API feature of Statistics Dashboard, but the contents of this service are not guaranteed by the Statistics Bureau of Japan. Source: Statistics Bureau / Cabinet Office of Japan. Reviewed 2026-10-27.

indicators.name: Australia Real GDP growth
indicators.context: Quarterly real GDP measures the change in Australian output. The non-annualized basis differs from the US headline convention.
indicators.description: Real GDP, chain volume measures, seasonally adjusted quarterly percentage change; not annualized. Source: Australian Bureau of Statistics. Reviewed 2026-10-27.

indicators.name: Australia Consumer inflation (CPI)
indicators.context: This is monthly all-groups inflation. Earlier observations include the monthly CPI indicator; the move to the complete monthly CPI in late 2025 is a measurement change to bear in mind when reading the history.
indicators.description: All-groups monthly CPI annual percentage change, weighted average of eight capital cities, original series. August is the latest included release: September CPI was scheduled for October 28, after this review. Source: Australian Bureau of Statistics. Reviewed 2026-10-27.

indicators.name: Australia Unemployment rate
indicators.context: Use the seasonally adjusted reading to assess labour-market direction. Small monthly changes can reflect sampling variability as well as changes in employment conditions.
indicators.description: Unemployment rate, persons age 15+, Australia, seasonally adjusted monthly Labour Force Survey; rounded to the published one decimal place. Source: Australian Bureau of Statistics. Reviewed 2026-10-27.

indicators.name: South Korea Real GDP growth
indicators.context: This series measures real quarterly output growth. OECD/FRED can lag the Bank of Korea’s newest release; retain the observation date when comparing it with the manufacturing survey.
indicators.description: Real GDP, expenditure approach, seasonally adjusted quarterly growth; not annualized. OECD Main Economic Indicators, retrieved through FRED. Source: OECD Main Economic Indicators via FRED. Reviewed 2026-10-27.

indicators.name: South Korea Unemployment rate
indicators.context: The harmonised unemployment rate supports international comparisons, with a reporting lag relative to Statistics Korea’s national release. It measures a different part of the economy from manufacturing PMI.
indicators.description: Unemployment rate, total age 15+, seasonally adjusted. OECD Infra-Annual Labour Statistics, retrieved through FRED. Source: OECD Main Economic Indicators via FRED. Reviewed 2026-10-27.
